note: 319366, nose right: the train's right side (far, +Y) to the left of the face; the face's left-as-seen cluster is lamp1 (far, z>0). Canon EOS 200D at 44 mm; the Commons original (5365 px) is smaller than the sensor's 6000 px, so whether it is cropped or resized is unknown: focal searched.

readings.gw-*: gangway door window opening: lines fitted along scanlines (top in the blue channel), virtual corners
